# 0.28.1 — 13 November 2026

Patch release on 0.28.0. Optional fields such as `author` are notes, not warnings: `lint --strict` no longer fails on them, and `--verbose` shows them.

## Upgrade

```bash
pip install opentide==0.28.1
export OPENTIDE_REPO_ROOT=/path/to/detection-repo
opentide validate --strict
```

If your CI runs `opentide lint --strict` to require `author` or `organisation`, set this in `.opentide/configurations/lint.toml`. Notes no longer fail `--strict`:

```toml
[metadata]
severity = "warning"
```

| | Before | Now |
|---|---|---|
| A rule without `author` under `lint --strict` | Fails | Passes, with a note |
| A note in `validate` / `lint` output | Printed | Counted; `--verbose` prints it |
| A rule without `configurations` or `response` | Only the editor reported it, as a warning | `opentide lint` and the editor report it as a note |

## Added

- **`--verbose` prints notes.** A note is a finding worth knowing that is not wrong, such as a missing optional field. `validate`, `lint` and `validate query` hide notes by default, count them, and suggest the same command with `--verbose`. `--json` and reports always include them ([#1028](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/1028)).
- **`opentide lint` reports a rule without `configurations` or `response` as a note.** The new `recommended` check, configured with `[recommended]` in `lint.toml` ([#1028](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/1028)).

## Changed

- **The analysis engine is [language-server 0.16.1](https://github.com/opentidehq/language-server/releases/tag/v0.16.1).** The editor and `opentide tui` report missing optional fields as information, and warn on Exabeam `activity_type`, `subject` and `outcome` values the CIM lacks (`exabeam_unknown_value`).
- **`lint --strict` fails only on errors and warnings.** Raise a check's `severity` in `lint.toml` to gate on it ([#1028](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/1028)).
- **`setup skills` installs the catalogue's `detection-engineering`**, the skill `discover` describes, and falls back to the packaged copy when it cannot download it ([#1015](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/pull/1015)).

## Fixed

- **`opentide lint` reports Graylog and YARA-L query warnings**, which it dropped before ([#1015](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/pull/1015)).
- **The packaged authoring skills have frontmatter**, so agents that discover skills by `name` and `description` find them ([#1015](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/pull/1015)).
- **`opentide explain` calls a warning-only YARA code a warning** ([#1015](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/pull/1015)).

It is a patch at the maintainers' request. `--verbose` and the `recommended` check are new, and `lint --strict` exits `0` where it exited `1` on notes alone.

See the [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/blob/development/CHANGELOG.md#0281--2026-11-13) for every change.

## Verify

```bash
pip install opentide==0.28.1
python -c "import opentide; print(opentide.__version__)"   # 0.28.1
opentide doctor                                             # analysis_engine: language server 0.16.1
```
